title: fix(objectql)!: a search over an object with no searchable field is refused with 400 INVALID_FIELD, not answered as every row
body:
Fixes #24284

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

## What

A non-blank `search` over an object whose resolved search set is empty is now refused with `400 INVALID_FIELD` (`param: 'search'`), instead of being dropped and answering every row. The canonical shape is a junction object: two lookups plus a composed formula title. The auto-default scans textual and enum types only, so its set is empty.

- **One judgement, one place:** `ObjectQL.expandSearchOnAst` (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`). `expandSearchToFilter` answers `null` for exactly two reasons, an empty term or an empty resolved set. Once the term is non-blank, the second reason is the only one left, so the refusal reuses the set the expansion already resolved and adds no second resolver. `find`, `findOne`, `count` (the list's `total`) and `aggregate` all reach this call, so every door gets the same answer: REST list, REST query, grouped read, dispatcher, SDK, and a hook's `ctx.api`.
- **The message** names the object and says why its set is empty. If no `searchableFields` is declared, it says none of its fields is a type the default scans, and lists those types. If a declaration exists, it lists the entries that name no stored field. If `internal: true` columns were left out, it says so. It ends with the two remedies: declare `searchableFields` naming a stored field, or mirror the composed title onto a stored text field. No tracker number appears in the runtime text.
- **`searchAll` keeps its skip and its `200`** (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`). Measuring this found one gap: the skip resolved the set over the object's fields INCLUDING `internal: true` ones, which the engine never scans. An object whose only text column is internal therefore passed the skip and reached `find`. Before this PR, that returned that object's first rows as palette hits. With the refusal in place it would have failed the whole sweep. The skip now leaves internal fields out, using the same flag reader the #22646 ingress gate uses. The pin is in `engine-search-empty-set.test.ts`. I did not find a registered object of that shape in the composed todo app: the palette swept 36 objects and answered `200`.
- `expandSearchToFilter` stays pure and non-throwing. Its docblock now separates its two `null` cases.

**Code: `INVALID_FIELD`, not `INVALID_QUERY`.** The request is well-formed. What cannot be honoured is a fact about the object's FIELDS. That is the axis #4254's explicit-override gate already answers with `INVALID_FIELD`, and the same code a search naming the formula title gets today. `invalidQueryError`'s docblock reserves `INVALID_QUERY` for shape mistakes that are "not about any FIELD". No new code is added. The answer is derived from the declaration, never from the caller's permissions, so it is the same for every caller.

**Where it landed.** It landed where the claim expected it: `expandSearchOnAst`, the one call site. The data door's ingress gate (`assertSearchFieldsAreSearchable`) is not touched. It judges only an explicit override, and a refusal there would leave the dispatcher, SDK and hook doors silent. The H1 measurement below shows the engine-side refusal reaches every door with the message and code already shaped.

## Measured over HTTP: before and after

The `examples/app-todo` backend ran fresh on SQLite (`pnpm dev -- --fresh --compile`), signed in as the seeded admin. A scratch fixture added `todo_lib_book` (`title: text`), `todo_lib_reader` (`name: text`) and `todo_lib_loan`, which has the `lib_loan` shape: `book` and `reader` lookups plus `title`, a formula `nameField` written `record.book.title + " · " + record.reader.name`. Seed data: 3 books, 1 reader, 5 loans. The fixture was removed afterwards and the tree is clean. The "before" run is the same tree with the refusal ablated in `dist/` (see Ablation), and it reproduces the card's report exactly.

| request | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /data/todo_lib_loan?search=zzzz-nothing` | 200, 5 rows | **400 `INVALID_FIELD`** |
| `GET /data/todo_lib_loan?search=Dune` | 200, 5 rows | **400 `INVALID_FIELD`** |
| `GET …?search=Dune&count=true&limit=1` (count / `total`) | 200, `total: 5` | **400 `INVALID_FIELD`** |
| `POST /data/todo_lib_loan/query {"search":"zzzz-nothing"}` | 200, 5 rows | **400 `INVALID_FIELD`** |
| `POST …/query {"search":{"query":"zzzz"}}` | 200, 5 rows | **400 `INVALID_FIELD`** |
| `POST …/query {"search":"zzzz","groupBy":["book"],"aggregations":[count]}` | 200, 3 buckets | **400 `INVALID_FIELD`** |
| `GET …?search=Dune&searchFields=` (empty override = absent) | 200, 5 rows | **400 `INVALID_FIELD`** |
| `GET …?search=Dune&searchFields=title` (formula) | 400 `INVALID_FIELD` (virtual field) | unchanged |
| `GET /data/todo_lib_loan`, `?search=`, `?search=%20%20` | 200, 5 rows | unchanged |
| control `GET /data/todo_lib_book?search=Dune` / `zzzz-nothing` | 200, 1 / 0 rows | unchanged |
| `GET /search?q=Dune` (palette) | 200, 1 hit (book), `totalObjects: 36` | unchanged |
| `GET /search?q=Dune&objects=todo_lib_loan` | — | 200, `hits: []`, `totalObjects: 0` |

The after-message, verbatim: "Object 'todo_lib_loan' has no searchable field, so 'search' cannot be honoured on it: it declares no 'searchableFields', and none of its fields is a type the default search scans (text / email / phone / url / autonumber / textarea / markdown / select). Answering every row instead would read as "everything matched". Declare 'searchableFields' on 'todo_lib_loan' naming a stored field, or mirror the composed title onto a stored text field and search that."

`GET /data/:object/export?search=` was NOT MEASURED over HTTP: the dev admin holds no export capability, so the route answers `403 EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED` before it reads the search. The route reads through `findData`, the door pinned below.

## Internal producers of `search` (H3)

| producer | verdict |
|---|---|
| `searchAll` (⌘K palette, `GET /api/v1/search`) | **skips** an empty set before it queries. Now judged on the engine's scan set (internal columns left out). Stays `200`; pinned. |
| `GET /data/:object/export` (the `search` param) | **surfaces the refusal**: it reads through `findData` inside its chunk loop. As `csv` it answers the `400 INVALID_FIELD` envelope. As `json` or `xlsx` the route opens its stream before the first read, so a refusal there ends a committed `200` with a truncated stream. That is the route's existing posture for every refusal `findData` throws in the loop. *(Corrected by the seat from record ③.4.)* |
| `GET /data/:object/import-template` (template mode) | **unchanged**: `search` is a template-inapplicable parameter, refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` before any read (`TEMPLATE_INAPPLICABLE_PARAMS`). It never reaches the engine. *(Corrected by the seat from record ③.4.)* |
| `@objectstack/client` `QueryBuilder.search` / `data.find` | **surface the refusal**: a passthrough to the data door. |
| MCP (`packages/mcp`), runtime, flows (`service-automation` crud nodes), analytics | **no producer**: no `search` key is emitted (`git grep` over each package's `src`, tests excluded). |
| import by-name lookup resolution | **no producer**: it does not use `search`. |
| server-side record picker | none in this repo. The console's picker sends `search` to the data door (below). |

## Pins

`packages/objectql/src/engine-search-empty-set.test.ts`, run over a real `ObjectQL` and, for the protocol cases, a real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`:

- junction object × `find` / `findOne` / `count` / `aggregate` × three term shapes → `{ code: 'INVALID_FIELD', status: 400, object, param: 'search' }`, the message's first sentence, the reason and both remedies. The driver is never read.
- an explicit `searchFields` (`['title']`, `['book']`, `['nope']`, `[]`) does not rescue it, because the allowed set, and so the fallback, is empty. This is H4's "explicit names all intersected away" case. On an object WITH a searchable set, that case falls back to the allowed set inside `resolveSearchFields`, so it answers filtered rows, never every row (control pin). It reaches the refusal only when the allowed set is empty too.
- a declaration whose entries are all unscannable → the refusal lists them.
- an object whose only text column is `internal: true` → refused, saying why.
- blank / whitespace term → every row, `where` untouched, on find and count.
- control object → filters; `zzzz-nothing` → 0 rows and count 0.
- `searchAll` over {book, loan, internal-only} → the book's hit only, `totalObjects: 1`, and no read of the other two. Over {loan, internal-only} alone → `200`, `totalObjects: 0`.
- `findData` (list / query shapes) over the junction → the refusal; control and blank term unchanged.

**Pin sweep.** No existing pin asserted rows for a search over an object with no searchable field. I ran the full `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` suites, plus every `rest` / `runtime` test file that sends `search`, and none flipped. No fixture needed a stored searchable field added.

## Ablation (the before leg)

The fix was committed first. `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `throw emptySearchSetError(…)` with `void emptySearchSetError(…)` in `engine.ts`. Injected spelling count 1, removed spelling count 0. The suite ran on the mutated source: **8 failed / 3 passed**. The 8 refusal pins went red, and the 3 preservation pins (blank term, control, palette skip) stayed green, which is the expected direction. The package was rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/objectql 'void emptySearchSetError'` reported the marker present in 4 built files. The HTTP "before" column was read from that build. Restore: `ablation-replace --restore` (blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty), rebuild, then `ablation-dist-preflight … --absent` reported the marker absent from all 14 built files and the working tree clean.

## Verification record

- Tests on merged head `bead2f2a4a`: `@objectstack/objectql` 441 files / 8288 tests passed. `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 244 files passed and 3 skipped, 20641 tests passed and 19 skipped. On the final head `fd4e073a6c` (after a second `origin/main` merge that touched neither package's source): build of the `metadata-protocol` closure plus `objectql`, both packages' `typecheck`, and the pin file (11/11).
- `typecheck`: `@objectstack/objectql` exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`, the new test file compiles with no ledger entry), `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` exit 0.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths) derived 71 families on `bead2f2a4a`. All 71 ran, each with its exit code captured before any pipe, and all exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "71 derived, 71 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN … a DERIVED zero". Three families first answered with a prerequisite, not a verdict: `check-engine-split-ratio` and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone; deepened), and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (8 unbuilt packages; built). Re-run, all three exited 0. The first run also turned up two real findings, both in the new test file, fixed and re-run green: `check:test-source-alias` (a dynamic import of `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` inside a clocked test body), and `check:query-options-erasure` (untyped option bags; the test surface rose from 236 to 245 sites and is back to 236). On `fd4e073a6c` the derived list is identical. The error / changeset / doc / ratchet families were re-run there and exited 0: `check:error-status-conformance`, `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:query-options-erasure`, `check:test-source-alias`.

## Consumer pointer (objectui, routed by the seat)

Read at objectui's pinned `.objectui-sha` `5e15928b`. The console's list quick-search (`plugin-list` `ListView` / `plugin-grid` `ObjectGrid`) and the record picker (`fields` `useRecordQuery`) send `search`, through `data-objectstack` `find`: `GET /api/v1/data/OBJECT?search=TERM`. On a junction object, that request used to get 200 with every row, which the list showed as if everything matched. It now gets `400 INVALID_FIELD` with `param: 'search'` and the message above. `ListView` shows the search box unless `userActions.search === false`. It does not consult the object's resolved search set. What the console should do: hide quick-search and picker type-ahead on an object whose resolved set is empty, judged by the shared `resolveSearchFieldResolution` from `@objectstack/spec/data` over the object schema (internal fields excluded). Where the box is still shown, render the refusal's message rather than an empty or unchanged list. No objectui edit is made here.

## Acceptance notes

- The changesets are `@objectstack/objectql` minor (the narrowing; it carries the `Clause-②` line and the ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker) and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch (the palette skip's alignment).
- The file surface follows the claim, plus the changesets. `protocol.ts` changed only at `searchAll`'s skip: its docblock, and the input to the resolution the skip judges, as measured above. `packages/spec`, `packages/rest`, objectui and docs are untouched.
